# Hourly Pay Calculator
> Free calculator that converts hourly wages to annual salary and salaries to hourly pay, with 2026 after-tax take-home estimates for US workers. Conversions use the standard full-time year of 2,080 hours (40 hours x 52 weeks). After-tax estimates assume a single filer, the 2026 standard deduction, federal brackets and FICA at 7.65%, before state tax.

## Calculator
- [Hourly to Salary Calculator](https://clippkailidaily-del.github.io/hourly-pay-calculator/): interactive calculator plus a $10-$100 an hour conversion table

## Hourly wages
